items.label: FIGURE BO.3.1
items.title: Measuring the vulnerability of people at high risk from climate-related hazards
items.content: The diagram illustrates the framework for determining if a person is at risk from climate hazards. The logic is: 'Person is at risk from climate hazards if...' they are 'Exposed to climate hazards' AND 'Vulnerable to experiencing losses'. 1. Exposed to climate hazards: Requires 'Any 1' of the following: Flood, Drought, Extreme heat, Cyclone. 2. Vulnerable to experiencing losses: Requires 'Any 1' of the following two categories: A) 'Physically vulnerable' (No access to water, No access to electricity, Low access to services and markets) or B) 'Unable to cope' (Low income, No access to social protection, No access to financial instrument, Low education level). Source: World Bank Group Scorecard indicator: the percentage of people at high risk of climate-related hazards globally, https://scorecard.worldbank.org/en/scorecard/home.
